body: PART 1 OF 3 | 11/11 November 11th, 2020. MO3 was shot 11 times on I-35 in Dallas. November 11th, 2026. Six years to the day, a jury came back with a verdict on Yella Beezy. $40,000 in cash pulled out 9 days after the murder. A lead detective who took the stand 3 times. A childhood friend who said the shooter confessed to him. Another friend who told the jury, "I made it up. " 12 jurors heard all of it. Now you're gonna hear it too. Allegations are not findings of guilt.

PART 1 OF 3 🧵 | 11/11

12 jurors heard all of it. Now you're gonna hear it too.
Part 1 starts with the beef, the 2018 tollway shooting, and the interview where Beezy said he'd "get his lick back."
🎥 Full breakdown on Ceddy Nash Uncut. Link in my story.
